what: Second, independent attempt at a crypto Falling Knife rule, after the v1 ATR-normalised rule (FROZEN.json) failed its held-out test. Close-based, the same form as the shipped equity and FX rules.
selection_rule: Unchanged, dev split (< 2022-01-01) only: highest lift in P(further 20% drop within 10 days) among configs firing on 0.3%-1.0% of coin-days; ties within 0.2 lift -> simplest. Candidates 15%..50% in 5% steps; in range: 25% (0.66%, lift 2.51) and 30% (0.38%, lift 3.22).
disclosure: The 2022+ held-out years were already used to reject v1, so they are not pristine. The decisive test is 30 coins never downloaded before this file was written (data/crypto_fresh).
pass_criterion: Ship only if, on the fresh coins, lift >= 2.0 over all years AND lift >= 1.5 on the held-out years, with fire rate between 0.1% and 2%. Otherwise report the failure and ship nothing for crypto.

crypto.dev_result: fire 0.38%, lift 3.22, P(severe) 66.7% vs 20.7%, median 10-day return +8.4% vs +1.0%
